newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was expected to add reserves to the banking system via overnight system repurchase agreements (RPs), economists said.
The Fed faced a small add need Wednesday, the last day of the current two-week maintenance period, economists said.
At 0940 EDT/1340 GMT, fed funds were trading at 5.5 percent, right at the Fed's current official target level.
On Tuesday, the effective fed funds rate was 5.34 pct, with a trading range between 5.0 and 7.0 percent.
